source: 29. What problem is GraphRAG designed to solve, and when is a graph-based index unnecessary or worse than ordinary ZXNAME0000XZ? [Advanced] GraphRAG targets questions whose answer depends on relationships or global patterns across a corpus rather than one or two locally similar passages. Microsoft’s GraphRAG builds an entity/relationship graph, clusters it into communities, and creates community summaries; global search can then reason over those summaries, while local modes use entity-centered context. The published work focuses particularly on corpus-level sensemaking questions where conventional local ZXNAME0001XZ is a poor fit. GraphRAG is not a universal upgrade. Indexing requires entity/relationship extraction and ZXNAME0002XZ-generated summaries, which adds cost, latency, storage, and new error modes. For direct fact lookup, exact identifiers, or small document collections, normal lexical/dense retrieval may be simpler and better. Use graph structure when the query genuinely needs relations, themes, or multi-document aggregation, and keep links back to original evidence because graph nodes and summaries are derived artifacts. [25]
zh: 29. GraphRAG 旨在解决什么问题，什么时候基于图的索引是不必要的或者比普通 ZXNAME0000XZ 更糟糕？ [高级] GraphRAG 针对的问题的答案取决于语料库中的关系或全局模式，而不是一两个局部相似的段落。 Microsoft 的 GraphRAG 构建实体/关系图，将其聚类为社区，并创建社区摘要；然后，全局搜索可以对这些摘要进行推理，而本地模式则使用以实体为中心的上下文。已发表的作品特别关注语料库级别的意义建构问题，而传统的本地 ZXNAME0001XZ 不太适合这些问题。 GraphRAG 不是通用升级。索引需要实体/关系提取和 ZXNAME0002XZ 生成的摘要，这会增加成本、延迟、存储和新的错误模式。对于直接事实查找、精确标识符或小型文档集合，正常的词汇/密集检索可能更简单、更好。当查询确实需要关系、主题或多文档聚合时，请使用图形结构，并保留返回原始证据的链接，因为图形节点和摘要是派生的工件。 [25]
